## How to include R code and output?


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
library(ggplot2)

(mytestplot <- ggplot(airquality, aes(Temp, Ozone)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "loess")
)
```
